api_keys_revoked_state_check.name: api_keys_revoked_state_check
api_keys_revoked_state_check.value:
("api_keys"."status" = 'active' AND "api_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("api_keys"."status" = 'revoked' AND "api_keys"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_versions_approved_metadata_che.name: knowledge_versions_approved_metadata_check
knowledge_versions_approved_metadata_che.value:
"knowledge_document_versions"."status" <> 'approved'
    OR ("knowledge_document_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_document_versions"."approved_by_principal" IS NOT NULL)

memberships_role_scope_check.name: memberships_role_scope_check
memberships_role_scope_check.value:
("memberships"."role" = 'organization_admin' AND "memberships"."workspace_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("memberships"."role" <> 'organization_admin' AND "memberships"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

theory_versions_published_state_check.name: theory_versions_published_state_check
theory_versions_published_state_check.value:
("theory_versions"."status" = 'draft' AND "theory_versions"."published_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("theory_versions"."status" = 'published' AND "theory_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "theory_versions"."published_by_principal" IS NOT NULL)

trainer_sessions_completion_state_check.name: trainer_sessions_completion_state_check
trainer_sessions_completion_state_check.value:
("trainer_sessions"."status" = 'active' AND "trainer_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("trainer_sessions"."status" = 'completed' AND "trainer_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

variants_source_external_unique.name: variants_source_external_unique
variants_source_external_unique.where: "variants"."task_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "variants"."external_variant_id" IS NOT NULL

whiteboard_resources_type_reference_chec.name: whiteboard_resources_type_reference_check
whiteboard_resources_type_reference_chec.value:
("whiteboard_resources"."resource_type" = 'task' AND "whiteboard_resources"."task_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "whiteboard_resources"."theory_version_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("whiteboard_resources"."resource_type" = 'theory' AND "whiteboard_resources"."theory_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "whiteboard_resources"."task_version_id" IS NULL)
